title: Integers, Rational Numbers, and Coordinate Planes
preview: Represent integers in real contexts, work with opposites and absolute value, and graph rational-number points on the coordinate plane.
description: Indiana standards 6.NS.1–3 and 6.AF.5. Students extend the number system to integers and rational numbers, then locate them on a number line and on the coordinate plane.

sections.label: 4-1 Represent Integers
sections.description: Use positive and negative integers to model real-world situations; interpret zero in context.

sections.label: 4-2 Opposite and Absolute Value
sections.description: Locate opposites on the number line; interpret absolute value as distance from zero.

warmupRefs.title: Which is more, which is less

sections.label: 4-3 Compare and Order Integers
sections.description: Compare and order rational numbers on the number line; write and interpret order statements in context.

sections.label: 4-4 Rational Numbers
sections.description: Recognise rational numbers (positive and negative fractions and decimals) and locate them on the number line.

sections.label: 4-5 The Coordinate Plane
sections.description: Plot ordered pairs with rational-number coordinates; identify quadrants and reflections across the axes.

sections.label: 4-6 Absolute Value and Distance
sections.description: Use absolute value to find distances between points that share an x- or y-coordinate.
